analyst.summary: Adani Energy Solutions runs India's most successful private power-transmission and smart-metering business, with a strong execution record, a multi-year order book, improving credit ratings, and a governance overhang - the 2024 US bribery case - that is easing but not closed: the DOJ has moved to drop the criminal case and an SEC settlement is proposed, with court approval of both still pending as of mid-July 2026. The business itself is in good shape. The stock, however, has already priced in a great deal of that good news, trading near its 52-week high at roughly 90 times trailing earnings, a level that assumes flawless execution and continuous large project wins for years to come, well beyond what even bullish analyst growth estimates support. We rate it Sell on valuation grounds: the company is executing well, but the price leaves very little room for anything to go wrong.
